from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
print('half-even 2.5 ->', Decimal('2.5').quantize(Decimal(1), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
print('half-even 0.125 @2 ->', Decimal('0.125').quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))

from tinycsv import parse
cases = [
    ('a,b,c', [['a','b','c']]),
    ('a,,c', [['a','','c']]),
    ('""', [['']]),                       # quoted empty field is a real row
    (',', [['','']]),                       # two empty fields is a real row
    ('\n\n\n', []),                         # blank lines only
    ('a,"b,c",d', [['a','b,c','d']]),
    ('"a""b"', [['a"b']]),
    ('"line1\n\nline2"', [['line1\n\nline2']]),  # blank line INSIDE quotes preserved
    ('a,b\r\nc,d', [['a','b'],['c','d']]),
    ('a,b\rc,d', [['a','b'],['c','d']]),    # bare CR
    ('a,', [['a','']]),
    ('"x",', [['x','']]),
]
bad = 0
for text, want in cases:
    got = parse(text)
    ok = got == want
    bad += not ok
    print(('ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'), repr(text), '->', got, ('' if ok else 'want '+repr(want)))
print('---'); print('failures:', bad)
